properties.name: v0.32.0 cut: the version string in reflow2.toml moved from 0.31.0 to 0.32.0 and nothing else did. The design meaning of a cut lives in the Release and its epoch, not in a version string, so the design holds. Accepted BEFORE release_includes_all so the manifest freezes the post-bump value — freezing the pre-bump one would have the release record that it shipped a file it did not. ⚠️ `refactor` is the least-wrong change_type and none of the twelve actually fits a release bookkeeping bump; that is the same gap #199 closed for defect_fix, unclosed for this case.
